title: Labeled samples from split assignments
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs, and let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $[n]$. Given $R$ pairs of assignments, with each pair consisting of an assignment on $P$ and an assignment on its complement, combine the two assignments to form a cube point and pair that point with its target value; the result is an $R$-tuple of labeled samples.

the inputs are $R$-tuples of assignments on $P$ and on its complement
